Her first album under this name, SAVED!,  came out on 20 October 2023, consisting of seven traditional Christian songs and hymns, and four of her own compositions. 

On 2 February 2024, she released SAVED! The Index, nearly an hour's worth of bonus material from the recording sessions for SAVED!

title: CMF2
desc_lfm_album: CMF2 is the second studio album by Corey Taylor as a solo artist. It was released on September 15, 2023. .
desc_lfm_artist: Born on December 8, 1973, Corey Taylor is the lead vocalist for both Slipknot, a nu-metal/heavy metal band (formed in 1995), and Stone Sour, a Hard rock/alternative metal group (formed in 1992). A commonly known fact among Taylor fans, he was a member of Stone Sour before he was in Slipknot. Taylor did not join Slipknot until 1997, when the "old" Slipknot (which recorded one demo MFKR and one unreleased album CrowZ) parted ways with original vocals Anders Colsefni.

title: THE OTHER ONE
desc_lfm_album: The Other One is the fourth studio album by Japanese heavy metal band Babymetal. It was released on March 24, 2023, by Babymetal Records, Amuse, Toy's Factory, Cooking Vinyl America, and 5B Records. Babymetal announced the album on October 11, 2022, and revealed it as a concept album. It is the group's last album as a duo, with Momoko Okazaki (Momometal) joining the band shortly after the album's release. According to the album's story line, each song describes a parallel world encountered by Su-metal and Moametal during a journey through alternate realities. desc_lfm_artist: Babymetal (Japanese: ベビーメタル, Hepburn: Bebīmetaru), stylised in all caps, is a Japanese kawaii metal band formed in Tokyo in 2010. The group consists of Suzuka Nakamoto as "Su-metal" (lead vocals, dancing), Moa Kikuchi as "Moametal" (backing vocals, dancing), and Momoko Okazaki as "Momometal" (backing vocals, dancing). The band is produced by Kobametal of the talent agency Amuse Inc., and their live performances are supported by a group of session musicians known as the "Kami Band".

title: INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
desc_lfm_album: Intellectual Property is the fifth studio album by American rock band Waterparks. It was released on April 14, 2023, through Fueled By Ramen. This is their first release with the label. It was preceded by five singles, 'Brainwashed', 'Real Super Dark', 'Self-Sabotage', 'Funeral Grey', & 'Fuck About It' which features guest vocals from blackbear. .
desc_lfm_artist:
Waterparks is an American rock band formed in Houston, Texas in 2011. The group currently consists of lead vocalist and rhythm guitarist Awsten Knight, backing vocalist and guitarist Geoff Wigington, and drummer Otto Wood.

The band has released three EPs, two of which (Airplane Conversations & Black Light)  were released independently with one released via Equal Vision (Cluster). Additionally, the band has released five studio albums (Double Dare, Entertainment, FANDOM, Greatest Hits and INTELLECUAL PROPERTY).

title: EVERGREEN
desc_lfm_album: Evergreen is the fourth studio album by American rock band PVRIS, released on July 14, 2023, through Hopeless Records. .
desc_lfm_artist: Pvris (pronounced "Paris" and stylized PVRIS) is a pop rock act formed by multi-instrumentalist, singer, songwriter, and producer Lyndsey Gunnulfsen. Over her decade-long career, Gunnulfsen has released four studio LPs: White Noise in November 2014 featuring the hits "You and I", and "My House", All We Know of Heaven, All We Need of Hell in 2017 featuring "What's Wrong", Use Me in 2020 featuring "Hallucinations", and EVERGREEN in 2023 featuring "ANIMAL" and "GODDESS".

title: The Jaws of Life
desc_lfm_album: The Jaws of Life is the fifth studio album by American post hardcore band Pierce The Veil. It was released on February 10, 2023, via Fearless Records. This is the band's first album not to feature drummer Mike Fuentes, with Brad Hargreaves of Third Eye Blind and producer Paul Meany filling in. The band parted ways with Fuentes in 2017, following allegations of sexual misconduct. It is the first album to have a title track. The first single, "Pass the Nirvana", was released on September 1, 2022, marking the first piece of new material from the band since their 2016 .
desc_lfm_artist: Pierce the Veil was founded by Mike Fuentes and Vic Fuentes in 2006, after the disbandment of Before Today. The brothers continued to write songs together and eventually came up with enough material for a new full-length album. Still backed by their label, Equal Vision Records, they wrote and recorded an entire album on their own in Seattle, WA with Producer Casey Bates. The brothers released the album 'A Flair for the Dramatic' on June 26, 2007 under a new name: Pierce the Veil
